name: keepalive
title: The keepalive whose own evidence may contradict it
description: Review P0.3 keepalive: a heartbeat every four to five minutes to keep the upstream cache warm. But the repository own guard comment records that cache misses are time-driven, a gap over sixty seconds giving a 34 to 40 percent miss regardless of prefix size. Measure before building, because the proposed interval may sit after the gap that causes the miss
creator: aixi
